# omniddi_ipam_node (Data Source)

Looks up any node of the IP space tree, such as a family root, container or subnet, by id, by CIDR, or (for a family root) by protocol. Use it to find the `parent_id` for `omniddi_ipam_container` and `omniddi_ipam_subnet`. Exactly one of `id`, `cidr` and `protocol` is required. A lookup by CIDR walks the tree from the family roots, one API call per level.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "omniddi_ipam_node" "ipv4_root" {
  protocol = "IPv4"
}

data "omniddi_ipam_node" "corp" {
  cidr = "10.0.0.0/8"
  type = "CONTAINER"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `cidr` (String) The network in CIDR notation, such as `10.0.0.0/24`.
- `id` (Number) The node id. For a subnet this equals the `networks.id` used by DHCP resources.
- `protocol` (String) `IPv4` or `IPv6`. Set it instead of `id` or `cidr` to look up that address family's root node, the `parent_id` of a top-level `omniddi_ipam_container`.
- `type` (String) Node type: `FAMILY`, `CONTAINER` or `SUBNET`. When set together with `cidr`, the node found must have this type.

### Read-Only

- `business_unit_id` (Number) Business unit the node belongs to (own or inherited).
- `created_on` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `description` (String) Free-text description.
- `has_children` (Boolean) Whether the node has child networks.
- `name` (String) Node label. Defaults to the CIDR when no name was given.
- `owner` (String) Owner label.
- `parent_id` (Number) Id of the parent node.
- `prefix_length` (Number) Prefix length of the network.
- `status` (String) `ACTIVE`, `INACTIVE` or `DEPRECATED`.
- `tags` (Map of String) Single-valued tags on the node (inherited values excluded when reported as inherited).
- `tags_list` (Map of List of String) Multi-valued tags on the node.
- `updated_on` (String) Last update timestamp.
- `vlan` (String) VLAN label.
